info.title: Chocodata
info.description: One web scraper API for the whole web. Structured JSON from 237 sites across 17 categories with 499 endpoints; 344 return structured JSON. Coverage includes the Apple App Store, Google Play, YouTube (incl. comments and transcripts), Reddit, TikTok, X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Pay only for successful (2xx) responses; median response time is 2.6 seconds end to end. Every endpoint follows the shape GET /api/v1/{site}/{resource}?api_key=YOUR_KEY&query=... The full per-site catalog is at https://chocodata.com/scraper-api. The concrete paths below illustrate the shared request/response pattern; the Universal endpoint scrapes any other URL.

get.summary: Generic endpoint shape: scrape one resource type on one supported site.
get.description: All 499 endpoints follow this shape. {site} is the target (google, amazon, walmart, linkedin, zillow, appstore, googleplay, youtube, reddit, tiktok, ...) and {resource} the data type (search, product, article, job, listing, video, transcript, comments, subreddit, post, ...). Parameters beyond api_key vary per endpoint; each landing page under https://chocodata.com/scraper-api/ documents its own parameter table.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Target site slug, e.g. google, amazon, walmart, zillow.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Resource type on that site, e.g. search, product, article, job.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Your API key, passed as the api_key query parameter.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The common lookup parameter (keyword, ID, or URL); exact name and extras vary per endpoint.

200.description: Validated structured JSON for the requested resource.

502.description: The target site blocked us or returned an unparseable page (not charged).

get.summary: Scrape any URL on any site through the Universal Web Scraper API.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Your API key.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The full https URL to fetch.

parameters.name: parse
parameters.description: Response parse mode.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code for residential proxy geo-targeting.

200.description: The page as JSON in the chosen parse mode.

502.description: The target site blocked us or returned an unparseable page (not charged).

get.summary: Example specific-item endpoint: structured data for a single Amazon product (ASIN).

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Your API key, passed as the api_key query parameter.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: 10-character ASIN (or 10-char ISBN for books).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Amazon marketplace TLD.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Content language as xx_YY (e.g. en_US).

parameters.name: add_html
parameters.description: Attach the raw page HTML under `html`.

502.description: The target site blocked us or returned an unparseable page (not charged).

get.summary: Example search endpoint: structured Amazon search results for a keyword.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Your API key, passed as the api_key query parameter.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword(s).
